description.value: Minnoz Restaurant + Lounge is an elegant yet casual full-service dining room and lounge inside the Coast Bastion Hotel in downtown Nanaimo, serving breakfast through dinner plus weekend brunch. The menu spans homemade breakfasts, appetizers, and a rotating set of daily lunch specials. Its downtown hotel location puts it within reach of the Nanaimo waterfront cycling corridor.
